content.comment_body: I previously created an application using the demo version of [product_name] V[version_no]. After purchasing and installing the full V[version_no], I am unable to open the project created in the demo version, receiving the error: 'xxx.lsc is not a FBD diagram, please check it.' I can't export or save the project in another format from the demo version and am unsure why the full version won't open it. Has anyone run into this issue? Thanks!
Hello, here’s a suggestion: since you have purchased V[version_no], try downloading the free update to V[version_no] and test again. [url] Hope this helps!
Thanks for your quick response, [user_name]. I'll try your suggestion and follow up once I test it.
Please upload your program as a ZIP file so others can assist further.
The issue was resolved by updating [product_name] to V[version_no]. Thanks for your help!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a compatibility problem between demo and full versions of [product_name], where projects created in a newer version were not supported by an older full version, resulting in errors. Downloading and installing the correct software update resolved the situation, emphasizing the importance of version compatibility when moving from demo to licensed products.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that demo and full versions of [product_name] will be compatible with each other, allowing straightforward opening, exporting, or converting applications despite differences in software versions.
